$description: Dark palette — Phase 1. Overrides the semantic layer only; primitives are theme-independent. `brand.primary`/`primaryStrong`/`accent` and every `status.*` color are deliberately NOT overridden here: they're fills (white text on top, 4.5-6.3:1 regardless of theme) or already pass as text on a dark page (orange accent: 4.59:1). Status colors specifically are designed for a filled/bordered treatment, not bare inline text — as bare text on the dark page they range 2.9-3.6:1, below AA, and no single tint can fix that without weakening their fill contrast below AA too. Phase 2's Badge component is where that constraint actually gets exercised.

link.$description: Plain rust (light theme's link color) is 3.35:1 on the dark page — fails AA text. Re-tinted to 5.11:1.

ring.$description: Plain magenta is 2.54:1 on the dark page — fails WCAG 2.4.11's 3:1 floor for a focus indicator. Re-tinted to 4.30:1.
